---
title: "OBS Studio"
---

Install OBS Studio and the Background Removal plugin from Flathub as user-level
Flatpaks. The `obs` role ensures that the user Flathub remote exists, uses exact
application IDs when checking OBS presence, and independently verifies both
installations. This avoids a false positive in the Flatpak Ansible module: the
plugin ID starts with the OBS ID, so substring matching can mistake a plugin-only
installation for OBS Studio.

```bash
ansible-playbook -i inventory -K playbooks/lab-stack.yml --tags obs

flatpak info --user com.obsproject.Studio
flatpak info --user com.obsproject.Studio.Plugin.BackgroundRemoval

flatpak run --user com.obsproject.Studio
```

::: {.callout-manual}
**🔧 Manual setup and configuration**

- In OBS, select **Video Capture Device → Filters → Effect Filters → Background Removal** to enable the filter.
:::

::: {.callout-check}
**✅ Check**

```bash
flatpak info --user com.obsproject.Studio
flatpak info --user com.obsproject.Studio.Plugin.BackgroundRemoval
```
:::
